name: Main
description: URL shortener web service — a single deployable Python app composed of 4 modules (config.py, db.py, shortener.py, main.py). Users POST a long URL to receive a short redirect code; GET /{code} performs an atomic hit-count increment and 307 redirect. All data persisted in PostgreSQL via raw parameterised SQL (psycopg2-binary, no ORM). Static frontend served from /static, root serves index.html.

functions.name: get_database_url
functions.description: Reads DATABASE_URL from os.environ and returns it. Raises if the variable is not set. Located in config.py.

error_cases.name: missing_env_var
error_cases.condition: DATABASE_URL is not set in os.environ

error_data.detail: DATABASE_URL environment variable is not set.

preconditions: Environment variable DATABASE_URL is set and non-empty.
postconditions: Returned string starts with 'postgresql://'.

structured_side_effects.description: Pure read from os.environ — deterministic given the same environment.

functions.name: get_conn
functions.description: Returns a new psycopg2 connection to PostgreSQL using the DATABASE_URL from config. Connection uses RealDictCursor as the default cursor factory. Located in db.py. Caller is responsible for closing the connection.

error_cases.name: connection_failed
error_cases.condition: PostgreSQL server is unreachable or credentials are invalid.

error_cases.name: missing_database_url
error_cases.condition: DATABASE_URL is not set in environment.

error_data.detail: DATABASE_URL environment variable is not set.

preconditions: PostgreSQL server is reachable at the configured address.
postconditions: Returned connection is open and uses RealDictCursor as default cursor factory.
Connection autocommit is False (psycopg2 default).

structured_side_effects.description: Opens a new TCP connection to the PostgreSQL server.

functions.name: generate_code
functions.description: Generates a 6-character URL-safe short code using secrets.token_urlsafe(4)[:6]. Located in shortener.py. Pure function (no DB interaction); collision detection is handled by the caller (shorten_url).
postconditions: Returned code is exactly 6 characters.
Returned code contains only characters from [A-Za-z0-9_-].

structured_side_effects.description: Uses secrets.token_urlsafe for CSPRNG — no external side effects.

functions.name: shorten_url
functions.description: Shortens a URL: if the URL already exists in the links table, returns the existing record's code. Otherwise generates a new short code, inserts it, and returns the result. Retries up to 5 times on short_code collision (UniqueViolation on short_code). Located in shortener.py.

inputs.name: original_url
inputs.description: The long URL to shorten. Must be a valid http/https URL.

validators.error_message: URL must be a valid http or https URL.

inputs.name: base_url
inputs.description: Base URL prefix for constructing the full short URL, e.g. 'http://localhost:8000'.

validators.error_message: base_url must be a valid http or https URL.

error_cases.name: max_retries_exhausted
error_cases.condition: 5 consecutive short_code collisions during INSERT (all generated codes already exist for different URLs).

error_data.detail: Could not generate a unique short code after 5 attempts.

error_cases.name: database_error
error_cases.condition: PostgreSQL connection or query fails for reasons other than short_code collision.

preconditions: Database is reachable and links table exists.
original_url is a valid http or https URL.
postconditions: A row with the given original_url exists in the links table.
Returned ShortenResponse.code is the short_code associated with original_url.
Returned ShortenResponse.short_url equals base_url + '/' + code.
If the URL already existed, no new row was inserted (idempotent).

structured_side_effects.description: Opens a DB connection to execute INSERT/SELECT queries.
Inserts a new row into the links table if the URL does not already exist.

performance_budget.complexity: O(1) amortized — max 5 retries bounded constant

functions.name: get_link
functions.description: Resolves a short code to its original URL. Atomically increments hit_count via UPDATE links SET hit_count = hit_count + 1 WHERE short_code = %s RETURNING original_url. Returns the URL string or None if the code does not exist. Located in shortener.py.

inputs.name: code
inputs.description: The 6-character short code to look up.

validators.error_message: Code must contain only URL-safe base64 characters.

preconditions: Database is reachable and links table exists.
postconditions: If a row with matching short_code exists: hit_count has been incremented by 1, and the original_url is returned.
If no row matches: None is returned and no rows are modified.

structured_side_effects.description: Opens a DB connection to execute UPDATE...RETURNING query.
Atomically increments hit_count by 1 for the matched row.

performance_budget.complexity: O(1) — single indexed UPDATE on short_code

functions.name: list_links
functions.description: Returns all rows from the links table as a list of LinkListItem, ordered by created_at descending. Located in shortener.py.
preconditions: Database is reachable and links table exists.
postconditions: Returned list contains one LinkListItem per row in the links table.
Items are ordered by created_at descending (newest first).

structured_side_effects.description: Opens a DB connection to execute SELECT query.

performance_budget.complexity: O(n) where n is number of rows in links table

functions.name: route_redirect
functions.description: GET /{code} — resolves short code via shortener.get_link(), returns HTTP 307 redirect or 404. Located in main.py.

inputs.name: code
inputs.description: The 6-character short code from the URL path.

validators.error_message: Code must contain only URL-safe base64 characters.

error_cases.name: code_not_found

error_cases.name: database_error
error_cases.condition: Database is unreachable or query fails.

If code does not exist: response is HTTP 404 with ErrorDetail body.

Response body is a JSON array conforming to list[LinkListItem] schema.

structured_side_effects.description: Delegates to shortener.list_links which performs SELECT query.

invariants: The links table has a UNIQUE constraint on short_code — no two rows share the same short_code.
The links table has a UNIQUE constraint on original_url — each URL is shortened at most once (idempotent).
hit_count is non-negative and monotonically non-decreasing for any given link row.
short_code is always exactly 6 characters, drawn from the URL-safe base64 alphabet ([A-Za-z0-9_-]).
All SQL queries use parameterised placeholders (%s) — no string interpolation.
Route declaration order in main.py ensures /links and / are matched before /{code}.
POST /shorten is idempotent: repeated calls with the same URL return the same short_code.
DATABASE_URL must be set as an environment variable before any DB operation.

data_access.rationale: Reads and writes the 'links' table which contains user-submitted original URLs (PUBLIC — URLs are not secret), server-generated short codes (INTERNAL — generated identifiers), hit counts (INTERNAL — analytics counters), and creation timestamps (INTERNAL — audit metadata). Also reads DATABASE_URL from environment (INTERNAL — infrastructure credential). No PII is collected or stored.

side_effects.rationale: SELECT queries against the links table to resolve short codes, check for existing URLs, and list all links.
INSERT new link records on POST /shorten; UPDATE hit_count atomically on GET /{code} redirect.
config.py reads DATABASE_URL from os.environ to establish PostgreSQL connections.
GET / serves the static frontend HTML file from disk via FileResponse.

authority.rationale: This component is the sole owner of the 'links' table in PostgreSQL. It is authoritative for short code generation, short-code-to-URL mappings, hit count tracking, and the full lifecycle of link records. No other component reads or writes the links table.
